source_row.extraction_instructions: Listing uses list_shells_override() to call the search widget's own JSON API (/api/v1/search/global?mainTag=learnAndDevelopPage&contentTypeAliases=eventPage&pageSize=200), filtered to parent=='Course' entries with a non-empty comma-separated dates field. 36 'E-learning' entries are undated self-paced modules and always skipped; of the 8 'Course' entries, 3 have no scheduled session ('No dates available' on their own page) and are skipped too, leaving 5 dated courses / 6 sessions as of 2026-09-29. Detail pages at /learn-and-develop/course-listing/<slug> are server-rendered (no extra client fetch needed); sessions come from repeated .course-booking-section blocks (date/time/per-session location/Book-now-or-waitlist button/sold-out label), fees from .location-price .prices .member/.non-member (one flat member+non-member pair applies to every session of a course — no per-session pricing seen), CPD points from .cpd-container, cpd_accredited from whether the first rich-text paragraph says 'Accredited by' vs 'Awaiting accreditation by', description/specialty from the .rich-text-wrapper prose paragraphs before the 'Who should attend?' h2, excluding the CPD-accreditation and 'This is a full-day ... course' sentences.
